meta.title: ESP8266 NodeMCU → I2C OLED (SSD1306)
meta.intro: Wire a 0.96" SSD1306 I2C OLED to an ESP8266 NodeMCU. Note the classic ESP8266 gotcha the pinout data guards against: the silkscreen D-labels are NOT the GPIO numbers — the default I2C bus is D2 = GPIO4 (SDA) and D1 = GPIO5 (SCL). Wire by the GPIO, not the D-number intuition.
notes: NodeMCU pins are addressed by silkscreen label; the built-in pinout knows D2=GPIO4 and D1=GPIO5, so a spec cannot quietly put the bus on the wrong pin.
SSD1306 modules power from the NodeMCU 3V3 pin (many are 3–5V tolerant).
Default software-I2C on the ESP8266 Arduino core is SDA=GPIO4/D2, SCL=GPIO5/D1 — both remappable in code if needed.
buildOrder: Power: NodeMCU 3V3 → OLED VCC, and a common GND.
I2C data: NodeMCU D2 (GPIO4) → OLED SDA.
I2C clock: NodeMCU D1 (GPIO5) → OLED SCL.
In code, Wire.begin(4, 5) (SDA, SCL) then drive the SSD1306 at its I2C address (0x3C typical).
checks: SDA lands on D2/GPIO4 and SCL on D1/GPIO5 (not the reverse, and not by D-number).
